mask.description: 0..1 density mask layer (a biome class mask, wetness, a painted mask…).

rock.description: Instance a generated rock (seeded from the scatter seed) instead of the 1 m cone proxy in `.glb` output.

avoid.description: Keep clear of an earlier scatter: no point within `radius_m` of any instance in that CSV (ecosystem layers that exclude each other).

follow_time.description: Use the project's timeline position as the scatter `time` when `time` is not given (the desktop's live preview: scrub the timeline and the population grows).

engine.description: Write `path` in an engine's own conventions instead of the plain formats: `unreal` → DataTable CSV in centimetres (X east, Y south, Z up, Yaw, Scale), `unity` → JSON in the Terrain's local metres (x east, y up, z north, nx/nz normalised).

spacing_m.description: Target spacing between points in metres (grid cell size); must be ≥ one sample spacing.

jitter.description: Random offset inside the cell, 0 (regular grid) .. 1 (anywhere in the cell).

seed.description: Seed for the jitter and the density test.

time.description:
Timeline position 0..1: the population grows over the timeline — every instance has a
birth time spread across it and matures over the following half; unborn instances are
not placed, young ones carry `age` < 1 (writers scale by it). Omit for the full-grown population.

seed.description: Seed: the same seed is the same rock.

roughness.description: Surface displacement as a fraction of the radius, 0..=1 (0.35 is a weathered boulder).

flatten.description: Share of the rock's height cut away at the bottom so it sits flat, 0..=0.5.

ScatterAvoid.description: An earlier scatter layer to keep clear of.

csv.description: Its `.csv` (`u,v,z,r`); relative paths resolve against the project's `exports/`.

radius_m.description: Exclusion radius around each of its instances, metres (> 0).

oneOf.description: Unity Terrain: RAW 16-bit little-endian, row 0 = south (no flip), Terrain Height = range.
Unreal Landscape: PNG16, row 0 = north, Z scale = range_m × 100 / 512, 8-bit weightmaps.
